title: Eiga Precure All Stars DX2: Kibou no Hikari - Rainbow Jewel o Mamore!
justification: The film is TVDB season 0 episode 1 "Pretty Cure All Stars DX2: Light of Hope ☆ Protect the Rainbow Jewel!". AniDB specials S1, the film release commemoration programme, and S2, the stage greeting, have no TVDB episode; by default they fell on episode 1, the film itself, and episode 2, the HeartCatch film (AniDB 7620). Both are unmapped. The offset is stated as 0 so the season 0 placement is published.
